figures.caption: Figure 4. Structural stability. (a−f) FIB-SEM cross-sectional image of the coarse-LPSC cathode composite and fine-LPSC cathode composite after 100 cycles at 30, 10, and 2 MPa. (g−i) XRD patterns of the coarse-LPSC cathode composite and fine-LPSC cathode composite after 100 cycles at 30, 10, and 2 MPa. implying severe decay of the crystal structure and interface. Specifically, at 2 MPa, the resistance of the coarse-LPSC cathode composite increases by 545 Ω, while the fine-LPSC cathode composite sees an increase of only 34 Ω. We attribute this to a more uniform stress exerted by the NCM811/LPSC composite during cycling. The effect of pressure in mitigating degradation is thus more pronounced with coarse-LPSC composites.
